mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.0% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that triggers corporate cost-cutting and reduced earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) signals a contraction in household demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-crisis recovery phase, a rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 index level indicates improving manufacturing output, which boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0 during post-crisis recovery, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6.0% signals a strengthening labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 6.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 800.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the residential sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 800.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.0% and a rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% per annum signals an accommodative monetary policy amid inflationary pressures, which reduces equity risk premiums and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0 and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (annualized), or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a rising consumer credit (RSAFS) above 350,000 million dollars signals strong household spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 350000 in a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
